citations.claim: net quantity must be declared in both metric and US customary units, in a specific location and minimum type size
citations.evidence: 21 CFR 101.1 (eCFR, fetched 2026-10-10) "Principal display panel of package form food": defines the PDP and says it "shall be large enough to accommodate all the mandatory label information required to be placed thereon by this part"; it defines the PDP area "For the purpose of obtaining uniform type size in declaring the quantity of contents", but imposes no net quantity declaration, no unit requirement and no location. citations.claim: check digit for 0 36000 29145 is 2, not 3
citations.evidence: GenSpecs 26.0 p.544 (rendered and read) §7.9.1 "Standard check digit calculations for GS1 data structures": "This algorithm is identical for all fixed length numeric GS1 data structures (including GDTI, GLN, GRAI, etc.) that require a check digit." Table 7-8: GTIN-12 positions N1..N12, multipliers x3,x1,...; "Subtract sum from nearest equal or higher multiple of ten = check digit". By hand for 03600029145: 3x(0+6+0+2+1+5)=42, +(3+0+0+9+4)=16, sum 58, 60-58 = 2.
